item.title: Atari XL tape preservation and autopsy
item.description: My first-ever computer was the Atari 600XL with an Atari 1010 Datasette. Recently I stumbled upon some old cassette tapes, one of which I used with my Atari (while the others were utilized with my Sharp MZ-800, which I will cover in a later story). Let’s see if I can recover the data from the tapes after such a long time and if it’s possible to make the actual bits visible with an audio editing software like Audacity.
